g.text: 0. The one metaphor everything else hangs on: THE COAT CHECK

tr.td: table / temp table / view / JS write buffer
the employee who stocks a room
one lowering clause in lower.pl, or one JS writer
clause runs, SQL string comes out
the employee files a carbon-copy slip AS they stock
one extra goal per clause, values already in hand
the engine visits every matching combination itself
a slip contradicts a drawer label
storage_defect(...) has a row in it
compile stops, points at the writer site
open the store, watch every customer
run all 211 programs, diff every value

text.tspan: the catalog-seed employee STAPLED AN ACTUAL COAT
the drawer closed without a sound

g.text: WORLD A -- today. nothing is written down, so only customers can find it
WORLD B -- proposed. every employee files slips; an auditor reads them before opening

div.p: what flows to what, both worlds:

tr.td: wrong value at a customer, maybe
one red compile, names the clause

text.tspan: 1. A BUG CLASS IS A JOIN THAT MUST STAY EMPTY --
state the contradiction, the engine hunts it.
2. you already do this: no-new-eprintln.dl audits
your CODE; this audits the compiler's OUTPUT.
3. it is cheap HERE because the compiler is prolog:
every clause already holds Plane, Column, Storage
in variables. the slip is one goal, not a pass.
and the slips ship WITH the emitted program, so a
.dl6 rail can re-run the audit at serve time
hand it the string 'text', get ticket #7.
the coat is stored ONCE, behind the counter.
every table column that used to hold strings
now holds TICKET NUMBERS. a 'plane' is any
place rows sit: a table, a temp table, a view,
a JS array about to be written. all drawers,
SQLite drawers DO NOT CHECK what you put in.
stuff an actual coat into the ticket drawer
and it closes silently. that single fact is
why all five doors were invisible
the coat is INSIDE the string; no card anywhere
in the INTEGER column, no error
= a decode view asks the coat check
for ticket 'text'. no such ticket -> NULL.
still no error, just a wrong value
management opens the store and watches everyone
= EXECUTE all 211 programs, diff values vs oracle,
one opus repair crew per family.
today's bill: 5 doors, 6 pull requests, a day
% the slip. same clause, it already holds both
% values in variables; filing is one extra goal

div.p: the same rule, goal by goal, in employee language:

tr.td: drawer C in room P is labeled TICKETS ONLY
W's own slip says they put a COAT in C
write W up, name the room and drawer

text.tspan: the auditor is the datalog engine itself:
you state the contradiction once and the
engine finds every instance. nonempty answer
